Definition: of Latin origin; a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor:--Pontus.
BiblicalUsage: Pontus is a region on the southern shore of the Black Sea, in Asia Minor. Luke lists dwellers in Pontus among the crowds at Pentecost, and Peter addresses his first letter to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus and the regions around it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the gospel reached Pontus early, carried home by pilgrims who had heard it in Jerusalem.
